title: Work with us · Creosote Labs
meta_description: Creosote Labs is open to collaborations and takes on a small number of outside engagements each year.
intro:
We are open to collaborations, and we take on a small number of outside engagements each year. The ones that work best tend to overlap with something we are already working on.

If you think you have one of those, tell us about it.

form.success_text: Thanks. We read everything that comes through here.
form.error_text: That did not send. You can reach us by email instead.
